title: SourceType
description: Classifies how a fact was obtained. Source types form a precedence hierarchy used during conflict resolution — explicitly stated facts outrank observed ones, which in turn outrank inferred ones. Precedence: user_stated (3) > agent_observed (2) > inferred (1) > null (0).

documentation.user_stated: The user explicitly told the agent this fact. Highest trust level (precedence 3).
documentation.agent_observed: The agent observed or derived the fact from conversation context without an explicit statement (precedence 2).
documentation.inferred: The system inferred the fact from indirect signals such as timezone from message timing or language from vocabulary (precedence 1).
